authoring: New source-owned native pixel geometry for the rigid crank, rope connector, hook and bounded water marks. No old well or character pixels are warped or resized. Structural art and canonical pails remain the retained PR1 drawings.

crank.policy: A rigid projected crank centered on its fixed axle. Sampling order advances with positive controller crank phase; reversal comes from the same signed turn state.

hook.policy: The attachment anchor follows the controller's pail grip; the rope joins the hook's upper anchor, not an unrelated screen row.

spindle.policy: Native winding highlights are clipped to the retained drum pixels. Their phase is the same signed controller crank phase; posts and masonry never move.

water.policy: Every water mark is intersected with the PR1 painted-water mask; masonry and shaft walls never become effect pixels. Reduced motion selects the first ambient frame while functional contact cues remain visible.

cache.policy: Preload fixed layers and native component frames; bound the final pose cache. Returning a copy protects cached artwork from caller mutation.
